description: This Java source file defines the class 'DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl', which implements a factory for creating and managing downstream sender objects within the Eclipse Hono client framework. It includes methods for obtaining telemetry and event senders, handling tenant timeouts, and managing client state.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing downstream sender instances, including telemetry and event senders, with tenant timeout handling.

methods.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and setting up tenant timeout consumer.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Clears client factory state upon disconnection.

methods.name: getOrCreateTelemetrySender
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to a telemetry sender for a given tenant ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getOrCreateEventSender
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to an event sender for a given tenant ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing associated downstream sender clients.
